title: How To Set Up A $2,500/Mo Airbnb In 84 Days [9 STEPS]
summary: Nine-step Airbnb arbitrage guide: sublease a landlord's property, furnish it for about five figures, list it; claims a couple of thousand dollars monthly profit per unit and linear scaling.

assertions.quote: you're going to manage properties owned by others so you're going to sign a sublease contract

verdicts.note: The arbitrage model exists and is used, subject to lease consent and local short-term-rental rules.

assertions.quote: they're going to get rent plus 100 bonus each month the property is going to get way less wear and tear

verdicts.note: Some landlords accept, most refuse on liability and insurance grounds; the pitch call shown needed a bonus to close.

assertions.quote: the golden rule is that the revenue is 2.25 X the monthly rent then it's gonna cash flow

verdicts.note: Cleaning, utilities, platform fees, furniture amortization and vacancy mean revenue near rent is a loss.

assertions.quote: you're gonna need about ten thousand dollars to set up your Airbnb from scratch

verdicts.note: Deposit, first rent, furniture and setup consistently reach that range in operator reports.

assertions.quote: on average a property can generate anywhere from 2 000 to 2500 a month in profit

verdicts.note: Some units in strong markets do, but market data show falling average revenue per listing, rising regulation and many units below rent.

assertions.quote: once it's set up it only requires about an hour of my time per week

verdicts.note: Guest messaging, turnover coordination, maintenance and reviews take far more unless a paid manager is hired, which cuts profit.

assertions.quote: within eight months you could be running four airbnbs hitting that ten thousand dollars a month Mark

verdicts.note: Each unit needs fresh capital and a willing landlord, and management load grows; linear scaling is a best case.
